embeds.title: Previously reported products (still in the 90-day window)

fields.name: Roblox Build — mobile AI creation tab (public alpha, New Zealand)
fields.value: Roblox — Roblox states a mobile-first creation tab inside the Roblox app that uses its AI tools, including Cube, which "turns a prompt into game-ready objects, from simple props to vehicles that drive and weapons that shoot," and already-launched Procedural Models.

fields.name: Autodesk 3ds Max 2027.2 — native 3D Gaussian Splat support
fields.value: Autodesk — Autodesk states "New 3D Gaussian Splat (3DGS) support in 3ds Max 2027.2 provides fast rendering, simple editing, and hyper-accurate output," with a new point object type and point-data modifiers to "edit 3DGS data or create point data from scratch." Arnold "now works with native 3ds Max 3DGS data."

fields.name: Adobe Substance 3D Painter 12.1, Designer 16 and Sampler update (OpenPBR)
fields.value: Adobe — Adobe states Painter 12.1 adds Skew Map Painting, Auto Rebake (rebakes only affected mesh portions), a Hard Surface Auto UV mode and OpenPBR support; Designer 16 adds a Shape Splatter v2 node, Signed Distance Field nodes, a 3D Viewer node and new displacement controls; Sampler adds Material Creation

fields.name: Fortnite / UEFN v41.20 — Control Rig for Sidekicks, in-world UMG widgets, LLM-powered NPCs
fields.value: Epic Games — Epic's release notes state Control Rig support for Sidekicks arrives with "three archetypes — Dog Large, Dog Small, and Cat Small" built on Epic's internal rig structures; creators can "drag your UMG User Widget from the content browser into the viewport to display your UI in the level"; and on July

fields.name: ABot-World (ABot-World-0 / ABot-3DWorld-0)
fields.value: Alibaba (AMAP/高德 CV Lab, subsidiary) — Amap shipped a public test portal for two interactive world-generation models — ABot-World-0 (video-based interactive worlds) and ABot-3DWorld-0 (3D-Gaussian-Splatting-based persistent spaces) — where visitors upload a reference image and generate an explorable world.

fields.name: Animation Graphs — full release (Roblox Studio)
fields.value: Roblox — Roblox moved Animation Graphs out of beta into full release, letting creators build and blend complex character motion visually via a node graph instead of hand-writing Luau scripting pipelines.

fields.name: Upgraded PSSR in Doom: The Dark Ages on PS5 Pro (Free Update 4)
fields.value: Sony Interactive Entertainment (platform feature; post authored by id Software's Billy Khan on the PlayStation Blog) — The PlayStation Blog states the upgraded PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) ML upscaler is applied to Doom: The Dark Ages on PS5 Pro from the July 7 update.

fields.name: 《逆水寒：新世界》 (Justice Online: New World) character rendering upgrade
fields.value: NetEase — NetEase's official channel states the New World version brings "全新超精度面部模型" (a new ultra-high-precision facial model) with improved contours, texture and lighting, a lighting system where hair stays clear when backlit ("逆光也清晰、发丝会呼吸"), and a "立体进化" (3D evolution) of hair-strand and cloth dynamics.

fields.name: AMD FSR SDK 2.3 — FSR Upscaling 4.1.1 on RDNA 3
fields.value: AMD — SDK bundling FSR Upscaling 4.1.1, FSR Frame Generation 4.0.1 and FSR Ray Regeneration 1.2.0, extending the ML upscaler from RDNA 4 to RDNA 3 cards.
